about: Middlesex Centre is a lower-tier municipality in Middlesex County, Ontario, wrapping around London’s north and west edges toward Ilderton, Komoka, and Delaware. Villages, farms, and Thames River countryside form a rural municipality rather than a single city. Highways and county roads link into London. About 19,000 people live in Middlesex Centre.
seoSummary: Middlesex County municipality of Ilderton, Komoka, and Delaware—villages and farms around London, not a city.
